scope.description: Actual useContext reads in a host-attested mounted slot of the pinned primary React DOM renderer. The executed program reads the exact current context value, retaining input-path and owner evidence. Provider identity, commit status and which update scheduled a render require additional evidence; this program does not claim those facts. Ordinary own-data values and functions are supported; accessor reads, proxies and other renderers are outside this scope; unaccessed warning descriptors remain opaque.
